visual.issue: Start here is overfull. Its content is about 17px taller than the page body, and flex shrink hides it. The FIVE MINUTES kicker is pushed up against the top bar (1px overlap; other pages have a 16px gap). The Tip box loses its bottom padding, so its text sits on the box edge. This is the third page every buyer sees and it is in photos 3 and 4. Trimming a line (for example, the empty HOME row of the top-bar map) would fix it.

2026 buyers can land in 2027. On 463 pages (Contents, Start here, Setup check, Year, Restart, tools and all 2027 pages), the NOV and DEC tabs open November and December 2027. The Contents 'Months' pills show no year and also open 2027. A November 2026 buyer who taps the obvious NOV tab or 'November' on Contents writes in the wrong year. Only the Head start card or button and the Restart grid reach 2026.
